exposure: Early elective delivery group and near-term delivery group
cohort: 120 babies with antenatally diagnosed fetal ventriculomegaly.
finding: Early elective delivery for fetal ventriculomegaly did not show significant benefits and was associated with increased VPS infections, repeat neurosurgical procedures, and medical comorbidities compared to near-term delivery.
birth_weight: Lower in the early elective delivery group (p < 0.0001)
